verdict.rationale: Jeeves Cash / global accounts docs claim up to 5% yield on multi-currency balances held directly within Jeeves accounts, meaning cash stays in-platform rather than moving to a separate institution, directly matching the story. However, evidence is entirely first-party marketing copy with an asterisk on the yield figure, no details on mechanism, eligibility, or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: independent verification of the yield claim, terms/rate mechanics, and confirmation across all supported currencies/accounts.
